origin.description: Recovers the correlation matrix from partial correlations.

arguments.name: m
arguments.text: A partial correlation or partial covariance matrix.

arguments.name: tol
arguments.text: Singular values at or below tol are dropped. The default follows the matrix size and the largest singular value.

origin.details: The partial correlation is inverted with the pseudoinverse and then rescaled to a correlation.
